records.canonicalEnglish:
Roy: Once again, you've done an excellent job. The investigation since then suggests that Zolias was behind the monsters being released into that mine.
Welda: Tch. Zolias again?
Sion: Can't something be done about them, Commander?
Roy: The Federation government isn't confident it can afford an all-out confrontation with Zolias. They are a military state, after all. However much Mars may lead in science, our overall fighting strength is still...
Joe: I wonder just how good the Federation's science really is.
Roy: ...Well, in any case, this has raised my standing with the Federation's leadership even higher. Thank you.
Joe: Thanks are all very well, but sending us out on one mission after another is getting to be too much. What we need is a little leave!
Roy: ...All right. Have it your way. Take a few days off for now.
Shoko: We did it!
Welda: Tch. So I'm stuck babysitting the brats again.
Sion: Well, I suppose it can't be helped.
Welda: Shut it, shorty!
Roy: On one condition! You are forbidden to use the Atraia.
Sion: B-but...
Roy: Those are the military's orders.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Narration: Sion and the others decided to watch the video letter right away. When Sion switched it on, a familiar image of Lucia appeared.
Lucia: “Sion, and everyone with you. There are reasons why I am in hiding.
“You must have been surprised to receive this video letter. But I knew you would visit this shop today.
“No, rather... it seems I can sometimes foresee the future, without warning.
“I'll tell you everything: why I came to have this power, and why I had to go into hiding. And then, please help me.
“I'll be waiting by the monument to Wey Dumna in the village of Daina.”

Those three have apparently put the Kingdom of Wyuria in a very difficult position.
